question: Plants which are grown under shade are known as:
solution:
The correct answer is **Sciophytes [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• Plants which are grown under shade are known as **Sciophytes**
 
• Sciophytes are shade-loving trees or plants.
 
• These plants have larger photosynthetic units than sun plants or heliophytes.
 
• Sciophytes are also known as photo phobous plants </span&g
